name: @britecharts/integration
description: Consumer-side integration tests: packs core, wrappers and react the way the release does and checks what ships

scripts.clean: rimraf .tarballs consumers/*/node_modules consumers/*/public/vendor consumers/*/dist consumers/*/dist-dev test-results
scripts.test:integration: pnpm run pack && pnpm run install:consumers && pnpm run test:tarballs && pnpm run test:require && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test:browser
scripts.test:published: pnpm run install:consumers && pnpm run test:require && pnpm run test:types && pnpm run test:browser
